name: WP Post Author – Author Box, Co-Authors & Guest Authors
author: AF themes

sections.description:
Author Box, Multiple Authors, Guest Authors, Post Ratings & Registration Forms for WordPress

WP Post Author is a powerful and flexible WordPress plugin that provides a complete solution for displaying author information, managing multiple authors and guest authors, collecting post ratings, and creating user registration & login forms—without writing code.

It is ideal for blogs, news portals, magazines, and multi-author websites looking to improve credibility, engagement, and editorial workflows.

Live Demo | Documentation | Video Tutorials | Support

🚀 Key Highlights

✅ Beautiful and customizable Author Box
✅ Assign multiple authors (co-authors) to a post
✅ Create and manage guest authors without user accounts
✅ Built-in post rating system
✅ Recommended posts to boost engagement
✅ Visual login & registration form builder
✅ Fully compatible with Gutenberg blocks, widgets, and shortcodes
✅ Translation-ready and theme-friendly

🛠 Key Features

🧑‍💼 Author Box

  • Display author information on single posts and author pages
  • Control section title, alignment, and profile image shape
  • Auto-append author box after post content
  • Fully customizable and translation-ready
  • Available as:
    • Gutenberg block
    • Widget
    • Shortcode

PRO Features
⚡ Profile tabs
⚡ Latest posts & top-rated posts
⚡ Author rating
⚡ Advanced color and layout controls

👥 Co-Authors (Multiple Authors)

  • Assign multiple registered users to a single post
  • Add, update, or remove authors directly from the post editor
  • Perfect for editorial teams and collaborative publishing

PRO Features
⚡ Author ratings
⚡ Profile tabs
⚡ Latest & top-rated posts
⚡ Single & all-author profile blocks

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Guest Authors

  • Create and manage guest authors from the dashboard
  • No WordPress user account required
  • Add, edit, or delete guest author profiles easily

PRO Features
⚡ Guest author ratings
⚡ Profile tabs
⚡ Latest & top-rated posts
⚡ Single & all guest author profile blocks

⭐ Post Rating System

  • Allow logged-in users to rate posts
  • Enable or disable ratings globally or per post
  • Helps increase reader interaction and content discovery

PRO Features
⚡ Top-rated posts block
⚡ Dashboard rating analytics
⚡ Login & registration page integration

💡 Recommended Posts (PRO)

⚡ Automatically append recommended posts to content
⚡ Display posts based on user preferences
⚡ Advanced filtering and layout options
⚡ Gutenberg block support

🧩 Registration Form Builder

  • Drag & drop user registration form builder
  • Custom login and registration forms
  • Google reCAPTCHA v2 & v3 support

PRO Features
⚡ Social profile fields
⚡ Custom login & registration page selection

🧱 Gutenberg Blocks

Available Blocks
– Author Box
– Author Registration
– Author Login

PRO Blocks
⚡ Single & All Author Bio
⚡ Single & All Guest Author Bio
⚡ Top-Rated Posts
⚡ Recommended Posts

🧩 Widgets

  • Author box widget for single posts and author pages
  • Custom author widgets
  • Social links and profile display options

🔗 Shortcodes

[wp-post-author] → Display author box
[awpa-registration-form] → Display registration form
[awpa-user-login] → Display login form

🌐 Social Links

Automatically displays available social profiles:

  • Facebook
  • Instagram
  • YouTube
  • Twitter (X)
  • LinkedIn
  • Email
  • Website

🎨 Theme Integration

WP Post Author works with all properly coded WordPress themes.

To display multiple authors in your theme:

<?php
if(class_exists('WP_Post_Author')){ 
    awpa_ma_multi_authors_list_post(); 
} 
?>

We are also working for the enhancement of the feature.

sections.installation:
• Download to your plugin directory or simply install via WordPress admin interface.
  • Activate.
  • WP Post Author blocks, widgets, shortcodes will be available for WordPress.
  • Shortcode [wp-post-author] will be workable.
  • If configuration instructions needed, go to WP Post Author admin menu and follow the methods.
